entries.label: TCP congestion algorithm
entries.help: Algorithm that controls how TCP adapts its sending rate. cubic is a safe default.

entries.label: Thermal profile
entries.help: Kernel thermal policy. Applied once at boot; it never locks the node, so other tools still work.
entries.note: Do NOT chmod/chcon this node and do NOT run from post-fs-data. Write once from kmgr apply after boot_completed. Optional opt-in 'hold' setting is described in the prompt.

entries.label: Pstore compress
entries.help: Compression used for crash logs kept across reboots (pstore).

entries.label: Entropy write wakeup threshold
entries.help: Entropy level at which writers waiting for randomness are woken.

entries.label: Custom tunables
entries.help: Add your own kernel node by absolute path and tune it like any other row.
entries.note: User adds an absolute path (allowlist roots: /sys, /proc/sys, /dev/cpuset, /dev/stune, /dev/cpuctl). Stored in /data/adb/kmgr/custom.json, then behaves like any other entry.
